title: Appointments Clause
question: Who is an officer, and who may appoint whom?

steps.note: Anyone exercising significant authority under federal law is an officer; Congress cannot appoint.
Tax Court special trial judges are inferior officers; the Tax Court is a “court of law”.
Military judges need no second appointment; their assignment is germane to the office.
Inferior officers are those directed and supervised by principal officers.
SEC ALJs are officers, so staff appointment was invalid.
PTAB judges act as principal officers unless the Director can review their decisions.
